richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Parbhani

c: Cotton, soybean and jowar fields surround Parbhani, and the city is home to the Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, the agricultural university for the region. Its hostels, schools and junior colleges are among the larger campuses in town. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Parbhani to such campuses, to housing colonies and to the parks of the Parbhani Municipal Corporation.

We make each machine at our Vasai factory, about 410 km away, and drive it across Maharashtra to the site, where our team or a dealer installs it. Marathwada is dry for most of the year, and April and May are very hot. The monsoon is moderate and sometimes uncertain. Hard, open ground is easy to find here. Shade and drinking water nearby make a bigger difference to how often the gym is used.

items.q: Is the summer heat in Parbhani a problem for the machines?
items.a: The galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for outdoor use and handle heat well. Metal handles do get hot in the afternoon, so mornings and evenings are better for use.

items.q: Can a hostel or college start small and add machines later?
items.a: Yes. Each machine stands on its own footing. We can mark positions for a second phase on the first layout drawing, so new machines fit without moving the old ones.

items.q: Which installation method suits hard Marathwada soil?
items.a: Grouting into concrete footings is usual on open ground. Self-standing installation is possible on some prepared bases. We confirm the method once we see photos of your site.
